call_body:
data.frame(row.names = 1L,
			    var = "<leaf>",
			    n = rpfit$inode[, 5L],
			    wt = rpfit$dnode[, 3L],
			    dev = rpfit$dnode[, 1L],
			    yval = rpfit$dnode[, 4L],
			    complexity = rpfit$dnode[, 2L],
			    ncompete = 0L,
			    nsurrogate = 0L)

data.frame(row.names = rpfit$inode[, 1L],
			    var = tname[svar + 1L],
			    n = rpfit$inode[, 5L],
			    wt = rpfit$dnode[, 3L],
			    dev = rpfit$dnode[, 1L],
			    yval = rpfit$dnode[, 4L],
			    complexity = rpfit$dnode[, 2L],
			    ncompete = pmax(0L, rpfit$inode[, 3L] - 1L),
			    nsurrogate = rpfit$inode[, 4L])

get(paste("rpart", method, sep = "."),
            envir = environment())(Y, offset, , wt)

get(paste("rpart", method, sep = "."),
            envir = environment())(Y, offset, parms, wt)

list(frame = frame,
             where = where,
             call = Call, terms = Terms,
             cptable = t(rpfit$cptable),
             method = method,
             parms = init$parms,
             control = controls,
             functions = functions,
             numresp = init$numresp)

matrix(c(rpfit$isplit[, 2:3], rpfit$dsplit), ncol = 5L,
                     dimnames = list(tname[rpfit$isplit[, 1L] + 1L],
                     c("count", "ncat", "improve", "index", "adj")))
sample(rep(1L:xval, length.out = nobs), nobs, replace = FALSE)

stop(gettextf("Argument %s not matched",
                          names(extraArgs)[indx == 0L]),
                 domain = NA)
stop("Cost vector is the wrong length")
stop("Initialization routine is missing the 'summary' function")
